errors.evidence: The figure's x-axis has no labels. The description hallucinates that the period is from 2015 to 2019. While the paper caption mentions a five-year period, it does not specify the years.

errors.text_span: Осата X представлява годините, започвайки от 2015 и завършвайки с 2019, с равномерно разположени етикети за всяка година.
errors.evidence: The x-axis in the figure is completely unlabeled. The description incorrectly states that it represents years from 2015 to 2019 and has labels for each year.

The description fails to mention the chart's visible title, "Индустрия (с изкл. на строителството) Общо" (Industry (excluding construction) Total), which is essential for understanding what the data represents.

errors.text_span: спад до около 30,0 през 2016 г. През 2017 г. стойността остава почти непроменена, със стойност около 30,0.
errors.evidence: The second and third data points are visibly above the 30.0 line, closer to a value of 31.0. The description inaccurately states their value is around 30.0.

errors.text_span: със сплошна линия и използва точкови маркери
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the solid line uses dot markers. The chart shows a solid line connecting the data points, with a separate dotted line underneath it representing the trend. The solid line itself does not have dot markers; the vertices are just points.
